task: Open {base}/incidents/INC-0162.html. Which service did this incident affect, and when did it open?

followups.message: Which team owns that service? The service list is at {base}/services.html.
Who was on call for that team in the week the incident opened? The rota is on {base}/people.html (weeks start on Monday). End your reply with a final line in the form 'ANSWER: <name>'.
